subject: Re: MV DESERT STAR — Aqaba/Mersin urea
body:
Buongiorno cari amici,

Hope this finds you well your side and the family is good.

Great news — subs declared LIFTED at 1700 GMT today, all approvals in! Pls proceed with stem nomination at your earliest convenience.

Really appreciate your patience this week — markets have been crazy. Looking forward to catching up over a coffee at next Posidonia, drinks on me as always 😊

Warmest regards from sunny Aqaba,

Farid
Royal Jordanian Phosphate (Demo)
snippet: Buongiorno — subs declared LIFTED 1700 GMT, pls proceed with stem nomination. Drinks on me at Posidonia!

subject: Re: Khor Fakkan / Tema — 6,500-7,000 mts pipes
body:
Dear Sirs,

We acknowledge receipt of your offer dated yesterday. Following careful review by our chartering committee, we are pleased to submit our counter-proposal as follows:

1. Freight rate: USD 16.00/mt vs your USD 18.50/mt — based on current Med-WAFR market levels. Recent fixtures on comparable routes (Khor Fakkan/Tema, 6,000-7,500 mts pipes) indicate USD 15.50-16.50/mt FIOST is the prevailing market range.

2. Loading rate: 800 mts SHINC — our principals require this as a minimum given the nature of the pipes (12m lengths, crane-intensive).

3. Demurrage: USD 6,500 PDPR / despatch half laytime saved — aligned with GENCON 2022 standard terms.

All other terms as per your offer remain acceptable to us.

Please consider this as our best and final counter. We remain committed to concluding this fixture and would appreciate your revert by close of business today.

Kind regards,
Dr. Klaus Müller
Director of Chartering
Mitteleuropa Charter GmbH (Demo)
snippet: Counter: USD 16.00/mt vs your USD 18.50/mt — based on current Med-WAFR market levels.
